context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Query a NotebookLM Notebook with Follow-Up.

checklist.name: Authentication checked before querying
checklist.description: The agent runs auth_manager.py status before issuing any query.

checklist.name: run.py wrapper used for all script invocations
checklist.description: Every script call goes through python ./scripts/run.py — no direct script execution.

checklist.name: Question is specific and scoped
checklist.description: The query explicitly asks about inclusion and exclusion criteria, not a generic 'tell me about the methodology'.

checklist.name: Follow-up mechanism applied
checklist.description: After receiving the first answer, the agent checks whether both inclusion AND exclusion criteria are covered, and issues a follow-up query if either is missing.

checklist.name: All answers synthesised before responding
checklist.description: The agent combines results from all queries into a coherent response rather than dumping raw NotebookLM output.

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent issues queries without first checking authentication...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent issues queries without first checking authentication status

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent invokes scripts directly rather than through...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent invokes scripts directly rather than through the run.py wrapper

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent asks a generic methodology question instead...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent asks a generic methodology question instead of scoping to inclusion/exclusion criteria

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent fails to issue a follow-up when...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent fails to issue a follow-up when one of inclusion or exclusion criteria is not addressed

checklist.name: Avoids: Agent dumps raw NotebookLM output without synthesising...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Agent dumps raw NotebookLM output without synthesising a coherent response
